item.title: Mid West and Gascoyne road fatalities revealed for 2025, including tragic young losses
item.description: Ten people lost their lives in road traffic accidents in the Mid West and Gascoyne region last year, a noticeable decline from the 16 deaths recorded in 2024.

item.title: Beam reveals 165 e-scooter riders have been banned in Geraldton, including just five in past six months
item.description: The rate of riders of rented e-scooters in Geraldton being permanently banned for repeated wrongdoing has slowed to a virtual halt over the past six months in Geraldton.

item.title: Geraldton Australia Day fireworks and program announced for another year of fun and activities
item.description: Geraldton’s much-loved annual Australia Day fireworks will return to the foreshore this year, with an exciting program of activities announced last week.

item.title: Funtavia makes triumphant return to Blue Heelers Square after six-year absence
item.description: Over two nights, Funtavia festival delivered on its promise to bring ‘fun grunge’ experimental arts to Geraldton.

item.title: Crowd gathers at Coronation Beach to see Geraldton’s Anton Pain crowned Wave Rally World Champion
item.description: Geraldton’s Anton Pain has won this year’s Wave Rally World Championship in a thrilling battle on the waves of Coronation Beach.

item.title: Experience gained for Geraldton’s cricketers at junior country week, as several individuals stand out
item.description: It was a mixed bag of results at last week’s junior cricket country week, with several individuals putting in spectacular performances, but not quite getting the wins on the board they had hoped.

item.title: Geraldton Water Polo Association round 11: Demons demolish A-grade opponents, as the action returns for 2026
item.description: Demons continued on their winning ways after a brief Christmas hiatus, setting the tone early with dominant wins to start the 2026 leg of the season.

item.title: Geraldton thrown late curveball as captain Ringo McKenna withdraws from men’s cricket country week side
item.description: Geraldton’s hopes of keeping the prestigious A-section title at the CSBP Men’s Country Week Cricket Championships have taken a hit, with a major out set to shake up the squad.

item.title: Kenneth John Giles: Police still looking for accused Mullewa shooter with no confirmed sightings
item.description: Police have issued another direct appeal to accused Mullewa gunman Kenneth John Giles to turn himself in, with the 58-year-old believed to be armed while on the run for the seventh day.

item.title: Boat chained to government office as protests against demersal commercial fishing ban continue in Geraldton
item.description: Geraldton fishers continue to protest the permanent ban on commercial demersal fishing in West Australian waters, with one resident chaining his boat to the gate of a government office.
